prompts.driver: Use case: stylized-concept. Production asset: a single looping SIX-FRAME sprite sheet for a retro browser arcade category mascot. Transparent background. 3 columns by 2 rows of equal-size cells, strict aligned grid, no labels, no borders. Same detailed 1990s pixel-art man and same small teal sports coupe in each cell, front-three-quarter side view facing right. The young adult driver wears a cream racing jacket, dark trousers and red shoes, leaning casually against the front fender with crossed ankles and one elbow on the hood. Car is a chunky 1980s arcade sports coupe, subtle cream highlights, dark rubber tires. A friendly confident character, proportioned like classic arcade beat-em-up fighters with detailed shaded muscles/clothing and crisp hard pixel edges. Six sequential idle poses: relaxed lean, blink, heel taps down, heel lifts, slight nod, settle back. Entire person and car fully inside each cell with generous transparent gutters. All six cars identical in location/size, all six characters same proportions and baseline. Approximately 150 logical pixels wide by 110 high per cell. Rich limited palette, no smoothing, no vector art, no tiny stick figures. No text, no logos, no landscape. Design must remain readable at 180px wide.
prompts.sport: Use case: stylized-concept. Production asset: a single SIX-FRAME animation sprite sheet for a retro browser arcade sports category mascot. Transparent background. 3 columns by 2 rows of equal-size cells, strict aligned grid with no labels or borders. Same full-body American-football player in all six cells, adult athletic man wearing a cream and burnt-orange football uniform, helmet, shoulder pads, knee socks and cleats, facing right in a classic 1990s arcade beat-em-up pixel-art style. Actual sequential throwing loop poses: holds brown football near chest; winds right arm back; steps forward and throws; arm extends and brown football is airborne just above right shoulder; finishes follow-through; returns to ready stance holding ball. Six different readable body poses, consistent character identity, scale and foot baseline. Detailed pixel shading with clear dark outlines, approximately 85 logical pixels tall each figure. Each full figure and football wholly within its cell with generous transparent gutters, no cropping or overlap. No text, no logos, no scenery, no shadows background, no smooth vector illustration. Rich limited palette, crisp pixel clusters, transparent background.
prompts.shooter: Use case: stylized-concept. Production asset: a single SIX-FRAME looping sprite sheet for an arcade shooter category mascot. TRUE TRANSPARENT background. Strict 3 columns by 2 rows equally sized cells. No labels, grid or borders. Same full-body adult soldier in all six cells. Original character in olive-green army fatigues, tactical vest, olive helmet and brown combat boots, carrying a fictional dark rifle firmly in both hands aimed to the right, alert but friendly classic action-game hero. Detailed 1990s arcade beat-em-up PIXEL ART, strong dark outlines, crisp pixel clusters, limited palette, no smooth vector look. SIX sequential side-strafing walking poses, facing right, weapon held level in all frames: right foot plants; left foot lifts; feet passing; left foot plants; right foot lifts; feet passing into loop. Distinct readable leg motion and slight shoulders/arms response, consistent head and body proportions, no shooting, no muzzle flash. Approximately 90 logical pixels tall, keep body at same center x and foot baseline across frames, all feet and gun entirely inside own cell with wide transparent gutters. No scenery, no text, no emblems. Must remain readable in a 180px category card.

reference: Owner's Pavement Punchers pixel-art character project. Existing character poses are repacked from that project; driving, sport, shooter are new generated six-pose sheets.
